lesson_intent.one_sentence_goal: Review Stage 2 by combining plans, reasons, conditions, comparisons, and polite reactions.
lesson_intent.real_life_context: A slightly longer but still controlled fika conversation near the end of Stage 2.
lesson_intent.communicative_function: Sustaining everyday small talk with one clear focus at a time.

dialogue_task.scenario: Anna and Erik plan a weekend activity, compare options, give reasons, handle one condition, and finish with a friendly decision.

main_focus.name: Stage 2 integrated review
main_focus.description: Combine the main Stage 2 patterns in a short daily-practice dialogue without adding new grammar.
model_examples: Jag tycker att fika är bättre än bio idag.
Om det regnar, stannar vi inne.
Vi ska bestämma imorgon därför att vädret är osäkert.
main_focus.desired_presence: Use a light mix: 1-2 att-clauses, 1 reason clause, 1 om-condition, 1-2 future-plan clauses, and 1 comparison.

allowed_supporting_grammar: ska and kommer att for future
simple reason clauses with för att or därför att

useful_chunks: Vad ska du göra i helgen?
vocabulary_target.desired_presence: Use familiar Stage 2 chunks and avoid introducing new thematic vocabulary.

dialogue_shape.opening: One speaker asks about a weekend or after-work plan.
dialogue_shape.middle: They compare two options, give a reason, and mention one condition that may change the decision.
dialogue_shape.ending: They make a flexible final decision and close politely.

target_complexity.repetition: review key Stage 2 forms in a coherent conversation rather than a grammar checklist

focus: which option is preferred and why
the condition that affects the final decision

sentence_focus: one sentence with better than or another comparative
one sentence with därför att or för att
one sentence with om and a realistic condition
one sentence with ska confirming a plan
